# v0.1.20 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.20. The capability version is 12.

`submissions capacity` reports the capacity waits persisted in poll state
for one repository, without contacting a worker. With
`--alert-after-seconds` it reports whether the oldest wait has reached
that age.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
